text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate on cross-region routing (eu-west -> us-east). Detect window: 2026-03-15T02:11:16Z. Spike ~12% 5xx for last 6m. Auto-run mitigation: none. Paging on-call for request-router.

dinesh: taking this — oncall now. ack @incident-bot. jumping into metrics and DNS answers.

alice: thanks — can you confirm customer visible impact and if any dedicated customers are affected? any correlation with recent config change?

dinesh: quick readout: top-line traffic shows increased error rate from eu-west clients hitting us-east backends. Not seeing backend CPU/GPU spikes. Error class is 502/504 at the edge. Flows that are pinned to eu-west still healthy. Looks like ~40% of eu-west queries are resolving to us-east addresses intermittently.

carmen: we ran a maintenance on authoritative DNS replica sync earlier in the window (eu-west replica promoted). I did a quick check — there was a short TTL bump to 600s on some records but I didn't see manual changes to geo pins.

bob: could be a split-brain DNS scenario: some resolvers getting old pin set, some getting new steering table. dig from two vantage points:


```
; from eu-west resolver
$ dig +short api.redwood.example A
10.1.2.3
10.1.2.4

; from global resolver
$ dig +short api.redwood.example A
52.11.22.33
52.11.22.34
```

That suggests inconsistent answers across recursive resolvers. note TTL on the records was high (1800) before the maintenance -> that can prolong split.

emily: customer impact: telemetry shows a subset of sessions to paid accounts saw increased latencies then 5xx; top affected tenants: AcmeAnalytics (~6% of their calls), BetaPod (~12% of calls). No billing impact yet but degraded UX.

alice: ok prioritize mitigation to reduce customer failures. Proposed: 1) temporarily pin eu-west prefix to the eu-west pool at the edge (force routing) 2) lower TTL on steering records to 60 and flush caches where possible 3) roll back any pending DNS replica promotions if safe. Thoughts?

dinesh: doing 1 and 2 now. CLI to apply pin (internal only):

```
# force pin region to eu-west for prefix
redwoodctl route set --prefix api.redwood.example --pin-region eu-west --ttl 60 --force
```

Applying... patching control plane routes and forcing immediate sync to edge routers.

incident-bot: ACTION: route pin command executed by dinesh at 2026-03-15T02:18:02Z. Notifying edge cache invalidation.

carmen: lowering TTLs on steering records now and triggering zone sync. TTL change propagated to authoritative replicas at 02:18:38Z.

bob: I triggered targeted cache invalidation for the largest public resolvers we saw (8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1) via support channels. also notified DNS ops.

emily: monitoring dashboards — 5xx rate dropping in the eu-west cohort that we forced pin for. overall 5xx from eu-west -> us-east down from 12% -> 1.5% in the last 3m. latency tail improving.

dinesh: still seeing a small fraction of clients with stale answers (likely due to resolver caching or private resolvers). we'll keep TTL low and watch for full convergence. Opening a follow-up runbook item to identify misbehaving resolvers.

alice: good work. start a customer comms draft for the affected tenants (AcmeAnalytics, BetaPod) — mention transient routing/DNS inconsistency, mitigation applied, current status.

carmen: noted. will own postmortem and investigate why the replica promotion left inconsistent state. initial hypothesis: promotion applied before control-plane route sync completed -> split responses.

bob: list of immediate follow-ups I will take: 1) audit recent DNS promotions and timestamps 2) ensure control plane sync handshake is added to maintenance playbook 3) add automated health check to detect split responses via multi-resolver sampling.

dinesh: handing off on-call to alice in 20m. I'll keep the handoff note: mitigation applied and holding; TTL lowered; monitoring looks stable; impacted tenants notified for now. If any regressions, page me directly. I'm adding links to logs and the quick graphs:
- metrics link: https://internal.redwood/graphs/route-errors?from=2543219000&to=2543222000
- dig snapshots: https://internal.redwood/debug/dig-snapshots/2543219876

alice: taking over oncall. will coordinate postmortem with carmen and bob. Please add an incident severity timeline and assign owners for the follow-ups (DNS ops + control-plane sync).

emily: customer comms sent to AcmeAnalytics and BetaPod with interim statement and expected full RCA within 48h. they acked receipt and asked for ETA on root cause.

incident-bot: UPDATE: SEV2 -> MONITORING. Last recorded drop to 1.2% 5xx and stable for 10m. No further paging. Incident will be tracked in #postmortems.

alice: closing the active pager thread. Carmen please schedule RCA with DNS ops and include the timeline, TTL handling, and a playbook change to avoid promotions without control-plane sync confirmation. assign Bob for automation of multi-resolver sampling. Dinesh will add a short opt-in script to force pin during future replica events.

carmen: will file the RCA ticket: INC-2543219876-RCA and invite relevant teams. target draft in 36h.

dinesh: thanks team. handing off final logs and notes to alice. signing off from active paging.

alice: thanks everyone. leaving the channel open for any late regressions. :thumbsup:
